diagnosis.defect: GAP-PRAVUS-INTERIOR-NAVMESH: no path joined the entrance tunnel jamb (176, 41.6, -8) to the interior. The route down the entrance ramp (ArchBaneIndustrialTunnelRamp32mV01 at 208,8,-8, a spiral from the jamb at 41.6 m to the tunnel cross at 9.9 m) stopped at (191.2, 38.1, -19.6), coming up from the interior, and at (204.0, 40.3, -16.2), walking on the terrain from the jamb.
diagnosis.cause: The terrain heightmap is a flat 40.27 m plateau over the whole facility (terrain tile t00000633_43, samples at 191,-19.6 / 188,-18 / 185,-15 / 180,-8 / 204,-16 all 40.27). The ramp's top coil (floor 38.5-40.8 m, ceiling 54.6 m) passes through it: under it the terrain is less than the 2 m agent height above the ramp floor, which walls the ramp off, and over the lower coils it is a floating floor inside the tunnel. The client walks players through, so the heightmap is not solid there. Doors, portals and tile boundaries were checked and are not involved: past the ramp the rooms were already joined (tunnel cross -> control floor complete 65.4 m; control floor -> chamber 170.1 m; -> prison 316.1 m; -> gangplank 96.8 m).
diagnosis.dossier_probe_correction: The dossier's probes from the 'control room centre' (224, 9.1, 40) start on the top of the Stasis Chamber (UsableInertDestBaneStasisChamber at 224,7.6,40), an island of the navmesh 1.3 m above the floor; every path from it is partial on either navmesh. The floor of the same room (214, 8.07, 40) is joined.
diagnosis.fix: MapGeometry.Load leaves out terrain triangles whose centroid has a floor of a terrain-cut mesh straight under it and a ceiling of one straight over it (Rasa.ClientData.EnclosureIndex). The meshes are listed per map in src/Rasa.NavMesh/data/terrain_cuts.csv; Pravus lists arch_bane_industrial_. 273 terrain triangles are cut; the tile and polygon counts are otherwise unchanged (900 tiles, 32,943 polygons, 2,357 under the terrain).
diagnosis.why_not_general: Applied to every mesh the test also fires under rock overhangs, trees and pond surfaces: on Pravus it cut terrain across the hills and the camp -> Frontlines route became partial (85 m). Restricted to the Bane industrial modules it cuts only the facility (128 of its sample points on the entrance ramp).

other_maps.method: terrain sample points every 2 m tested against the arch_* meshes of each map only (the fix's test with the arch_ prefix); counts of points where terrain runs inside a building or tunnel, and the meshes involved. Paths were not probed; a count is a candidate, not a confirmed defect.
